preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
At least one user must hold some NMETA tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxAmount(0) to set the maximum transaction amount to zero. This will cause all subsequent transfer() and transferFrom() calls to fail due to the require(amount <= maxTxAmount) check in _transfer(), effectively locking all user funds in the contract.
